newsitem.title: USA: Ambassador to buy 3 properties for $32.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ambassador to buy 3 properties for $32.3 mln.

text.p: Ambassador Apartments Inc said Tuesday it purchased three garden apartment properties containing 824 units for a total of about $32.3 million.

Two of the properties are located in Phoenix and Tempe, Arizona and the third is located in Nashville, Tennessee. The Arizona properties were purchased from the Pima County Industrial Revenue Bond Authority and the Nashville property was purchased from a Balcor fund, Ambassador said.

As part of the Nashville purchase, Ambassador assumed $8.6 million of tax exempt bonds issued by the Industrial Development Board of the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, the real estate investment trust said.
